title: Atlassian's First Target Was a Graduate Salary and $10,000 of Debt
conflicts: Salary goal: $48,500 PwC graduate salary (Farquhar, SMH/AFR 2014) vs friends earning $50,000 (Farquhar, SMH 2010); story quotes $48,500. Founders' pay: $15,000 each for two years (2014) vs about $300 a week of scholarship money for three years (2010); story uses 2014. Profitability: 'from day one' (SMH 2010, 2014) vs 'past ten fiscal years' (Fortune 2015) vs 'unable to make money' before the pivot (How I Built This summary); no profitability claim made. Years without outside funding: eight (SMH 2014, Accel in 2010) vs ten (AFR 2021); story follows 2010. Start location: garage (SMH 2010) vs shared house in Glebe (SMH 2014); story uses Glebe for the support work only.
notes: Quote stance 'complicates' (Laozi on contentment against the founders' later billion-dollar aim). The shared web-search budget was exhausted before this entry, so sources were found by following references from Wikipedia and the cited articles rather than by search; Wikipedia itself is not cited. The American Airlines fax story is attributed to Atlassian's own 'company lore'.
